annotations.title: Set up an automation (spends balance as it runs)

description: Set up an automation: Spoofy places ordinary orders for the user on a plan. Kinds: spread (a total over time, e.g. {"kind":"spread","service":12,"link":"…","quantity":10000,"over":"3d"}; pace "steady" or "front" for an S-curve growth plan), scheduled (one order at start_at), recurring (every "1d"/"6h"/"1w", optional at "14:00" + timezone, with times, until or budget), split (past one order's max), campaign (steps [{service, link, quantity, offset_minutes, over_minutes}] or template: "token-launch" + links), keep_above (target + days + budget; public Telegram channels/groups and YouTube videos only), feed (a public Telegram channel, YouTube channel or RSS feed: every new post gets quantity of service; max_per_day, budget). Service ids come from find_services. THIS SPENDS THE USER'S REAL BALANCE: each run is charged when it goes (never above the planned price). Call first without confirm (or with dry_run: true): you get the plan — every run's time, size and cost, the total and the balance. Tell the user the total and timing and get their explicit OK, then call again with confirm: true and an idempotency_key. Errors: bad_automation / bad_schedule (the message says what to change), budget_required, count_not_readable (keep_above only reads those links), bad_feed (X has no public feed), too_many_automations, over_order_cap / platform_not_allowed / read_only_key (this key's limits).

automation.description: The automation, exactly as POST /api/v1/automations takes it: {"kind": …, "service": …, "link": …, …}.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually create it. Only after the user agreed to the plan and its cost.

dry_run.description: true = plan and price only, create nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Unique string per intended automation; a retry with the same key returns the first one.
